title: Magik Ell
description: A basic and broken friend in chat that spawns a block of anything in the game at request, and could brick your save. Read Description please.
body:
**BEWARE: I DON'T KNOW WHAT I'M DOING THIS COULD ROYALLY MESS UP ANYTHING AND EVERYTHING. USE AT YOUR OWN RISK!!!**
_[Not Multiplayer Friendly]_

![warning: use at your own risk (warning.png)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21cc77f5d2571f135a0037369431ed74c223f803_0.webp)


Magik Ell only knows 2 things. Blocks. And house.
say in chat, "I wanta anvil plsssss"
and it spawns an anvil nearby.

this works for any block in the game including modded ones, YES, it's broken as heck.
order and extra words don't matter **_as long as it has the Block's ID somewhere in the sentence_**.

**example 1:** "Gimme Gold" does nothing, "Gimme Gold Block" spawns gold block.

_**<Despite my examples, this mod is in no way shape or form affiliated with Computer Craft. Please do not bother them because I'm incompetent.>**_

**example 2:** "Make computer!" does nothing, "Make normal computer!" spawns a computer from computer craft if you have that mod installed.

**example 3:** Example 1 lied. Kinda. If you say "Gimme Gold" it does nothing still, instead if you say "Ell gimme gold" or simply include "ell" she'll spawn any ore per request.
Eg. "Ell! diamond!" and "Diamond ore!" both place an diamond ore block in front of you. 

Back to example 2.
Why Normal? and not just computer? Because A. computer craft uses the block ID computer_normal for it's computer... AND B. I can't figure out how to add BLOCKS.COMPUTER_NORMAL to my mod without getting an error. **_SO_**. normal computer or computer normal it will stay.

"house" basically spawns an 10x10x10 obsidian and oak box that has a crafting table, furnace, materials to make a bed, and a free shulker box. Inside the shulker box can have ores if you use it underground and ores are replaced.
Example: "GIMME HOUSE NOW!!!!!" **or**,
"
Noble Ell, Master of Craft,

I beseech thee: lay thy hand to the stone and timber! I seek a dwelling shaped by thy skill—a fortress for my spirit and a roof against the tempests.

Give thou the command, and let the foundations be struck, that a house may rise where now there is but empty air.

What sayest thou?
"
an they will simply make an house ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ <- he's missing an arm and idk why.

On that note. Let me explain why and how this could break everything.
[Probably for modders]

1. Magik Ell "Says" it supports version 1.21.11+ **HOWEVER**. Updating the Gradle with said properties resulted in errors I did not feel like fixing. Since it's technically working as is. Therefore.
On the surface it says 1.21.11, but in reality, it physically supports version 1.21.7.

**SOURCE CODE HERE:** <https://github.com/BitesizeKira/Magik-Ell>

Specifically the lines affected by updating Gradle to match the 1.21.11 tag, results in 2 errors.
1. "import net.minecraft.resources.**_ResourceLocation_**;"
and
2. "id.**_getPath_**()

I wish I could elaborate more, but in doing so I'd just be posting the raw code of the mod at that point as essentially that's all this does, I believe for the ores specifically.
I'm at an impasse since from what I can tell. It technically works just fine for some reason.

**AGAIN, I DON'T KNOW WHAT I'M DOING! BONK ME IN THE COMMENTS IF IT DESTROYS YOUR COMPUTER!**
